text:
alex: ap-southeast-1 queue depth for model=mosaic-xl jumped 3x in 10m — tail latency 2.8s -> 6.9s, queued tokens ~45k. Anyone else seeing this?
mina: yep. PGs 12/14 at 100% load, eviction count spiking. No deploys from infra last hour.
ops-bot: Autoscaler: scaled mosaic-xl-apac from 0->2 pods at 02:12 UTC; reason=builtin-surge; added 2 GPUs
sam: traced incoming traffic — large spike from api-key=acme-corp (burst tests). They were supposed to be rate-limited but client-side misconfig.
carla: can we apply short-term admission control? Suggest per-customer cap and fallback to mosaic-l-quant at 60% fidelity until backlog clears.
alex: agree. Plan: 1) add per-key soft cap 25rps for acme-corp for 30m 2) enable model-fallback route for mosaic-xl -> mosaic-l-quant when queue>3000 tokens 3) adjust fairshare weight to deprioritize non-enterprise
sam: I can push the rate cap. CLI:
```
redwoodctl rate-limit set --key acme-corp --rps 25 --duration 30m
```
mina: for fallback, here's routing snippet:
```
route:
  model: mosaic-xl
  overflow:
    threshold_tokens: 3000
    fallback_model: mosaic-l-quant
```
carla: note reroute will increase latency for those requests ~+120ms and cost may go up due to cross-region if fallback is in us-west2. make sure ops budget OK.
alex: good point. We'll prefer local fallback to mosaic-l-quant in apac. If local capacity exhausted, then cross-region fallback to us-west2 with spike budget tag.
ops-bot: AdmissionControl: applied fairshare change, deprioritized non-sla keys by 0.6 weight at 02:18 UTC
sam: rate cap applied, confirming drop in incoming from acme. backlog dropping but head times still ~4.1s.
mina: started eviction_sweep on stale queued requests >90s. Command:
```
redwoodctl queue trim --model mosaic-xl --older-than 90s --dry-run=false
```
carla: filing ticket IN-523: "apac mosaic-xl burst — acme rate cap + fallback" and tagging finance for cost monitoring.
alex: baseline: keep monitors for 30m, if backlog not under 20k tokens escalate to full region spillover and open dedicated capacity. For now leaving open mitigation ticket.
sam: ack, monitoring dashboards look better. :thumbsup:
mina: will follow up with a short retro in eng-infra tomorrow.
carla: thanks everyone, marking thread resolved for now :white_check_mark:
